body.name: \(\mathfrak B_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak B_{n,\alpha}=\{\mathcal C_n=(L_n,U_n):L_n\text{ and }U_n\text{ are jointly measurable finite real-valued functions of the observed sample and }a\in I,\ P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}(L_n(a)\le U_n(a)\text{ for every }a\in I)=1\text{ for every }P\in\mathcal M,\ \inf_{P\in\mathcal M}P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}(L_n(a)\le\mu(a)\le U_n(a)\text{ for every }a\in I)\ge1-\alpha\}\). Thus \(W_n\ge0\) almost surely under every \(P\in\mathcal M\).
